text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to advise Community Council concerning an application submitted by the owner of 5 Alderton Court for a site-specific Fence Exemption pursuant to Section 447-1.2 B(1) of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447 – Fences. The applicant is seeking permission to maintain an existing wood fence located along the rear perimeter lot line of the property. The fence exceeds the maximum permitted height of 2.0 metres and measures between approximately 2.25 metres and 2.97 metres in height when calculated using average grade in accordance with Chapter 447. The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until the first regular meeting of the next term of the Etobicoke York Community Council.
